figurative_meaning_bn: আদি বা অন্ত; শুরু বা শেষ
figurative_meaning_en: Beginning or end; start or finish, implying complete lack of understanding
similar_in_english: Can't make heads or tails of it
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই বইটির আগামাথা আমার কাছে অসম্ভব লাগছে।
example_sentences_in_english: I can't understand anything from beginning to end.
This book seems impossible to me from start to finish.
note: Often used to express total bewilderment or inability to grasp something entirely
